messages:
maria: Morning — posting quick async standup for prop-fill onboarding.
- Did: wired prop-fill into bento staging (customer-support-v2 promptset), ran a quick smoke eval (2k samples), built the bento artifact and pushed to staging bucket.
- Blockers: seeing a tokenization mismatch on the Spanish+emoji subset that truncates replies oddly; one CI integration test in the deploy pipeline is failing on streaming handshake.
- Today: triage tokenizer mismatch, open PR for tokenizer mapping fix, kick off full eval sweep (10k samples), ask infra for a short-lived GPU for the sweep.

kevin: For the emoji/token issue — saw this crop up once when mapping unicode variation selectors. Can you paste the exact failing sample? I can also give you a T4 for an hour later today (11:30 PDT) to repro.

maria: Sample below (from the failing eval batch):
```json
{"input":"¡Hola 👋, necesito ayuda con mi pedido #1234","output":"Hola, ¿cómo puedo ayudar?"}
```
The model often drops the emoji or truncates right after it; seems like token boundary shift.

ravi: quick perf note: prop-fill in bento staging bumped p50 for short contexts from ~42ms -> ~57ms when KV cache is disabled. My hunch: continuous batching got disabled by a runtime flag flip. I'll open a tiny config PR to re-enable continuous batching for the bento runtime.

sophia: tagging @eng-runtime for visibility — @kevin can you join a quick repro at 11:30? :calendar:

kevin: Yep, I'll join. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: smoke-evals finished: 50/50 regressions detected on the Spanish-emoji subset. Full report: /evals/1739876500/report (summary and failing examples attached).

maria: Thanks all — I'll prioritize tokenizer PR and the eval sweep. ETA for PR ~2 hours. Will update here when PR is up and when sweep results land.

ravi: If you want I can land the batching flag patch to staging once CI passes — low-risk. Ping me when PR is ready for review.

maria: Appreciated. Requesting reviews from @sophia and @kevin when I open the PR. Will also drop the failing subset link in the PR description so reviewers can see examples.
